native_consumer.scope: Includes all native API/page changes. The later a73e825b50 changes affect Wasm browser modules and are included in the matching SDK.

contract_checks: Stored supported wire-v7 manifests survive a simulated next live protocol version; new publication requires the current registered runtime.
Invalid active WGSL and unsupported playable values leave the prior channel unchanged.
Native retry, access, immutable saved content, rollback and revocation checks pass.

browser.faults: Acknowledgment loss/hold/failure and fatal status are deliberately injected; this does not claim a real hardware device-loss pass.
browser.deployment: Frozen, process-local compiled runtime and native storage. Dynamic loopback origins are an isolated fixture, not a hosted production release.

early_mouse_proof.scope: Trusted real-browser mouse gesture; no pre-click wait. Subsequent touch and immediate mouse click still leave pointer lock released. Gesture times are document-clock samples, not world-load performance.
early_mouse_proof.outside_early_window: Run17 acquired pointer lock but did not meet the early-click predicate; it is excluded from early-click evidence.

browser.visual_review: Codex reviewed private desktop, mobile, held-load, and release-review captures. No human review is claimed.
